task: Exact complete directed slider visibility relation on 8- and 16-cell ternary lines; blocker squares included, source square excluded
outputs: one u16 target mask per possible slider source, not an attack union or checksum

datasets.constructed16: Every distinct slider/blocker pair against empty background; every single slider; slider pairs; boundary-local and long-ray configurations included by enumeration

action_classes: All 3 substitutions at each of 16 cells, including no-op: 48 exact outputs per selected root; first 256 random16 roots and all constructed16 roots
lifting: Toy integer boundary prefilter plus pairwise reversible Haar/S lifting, not JPEG XR conformance; exact inverse then visibility composition vs discarding all detail coefficients

timing.compiler: rustc release opt-level3 portable default target
timing.inputs: first4096 random16 roots; exhaustive8 for full8 LUT
timing.metric: median ns/complete relation; full class ns/48-query class; black_box outputs
timing.limitations: exploratory single CPU wall-clock; includes lookup-code extraction and transform when applicable; no SIMD speedup claim

resource_limits: No GPU, full engine, neural training, huge tables, or media. Full16 LUT prohibited (3^16 entries).
claims_boundary: Overlap union/averaging is not alias cancellation. Reversible transform invertibility is not a proof of a nonlinear visibility operator. Exact boundary composition will be checked against a separately written direct source-ray oracle.
